metadata.title: Verify Test Passes
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Verify implemented fix resolves test failure. Use as final step in test fix process.

output.description: Test verification results and debug cleanup

specificActions: Run the specific test that was failing
If passed: Remove temporary debug logging; verify no debug artifacts remain; document success
If failed: Capture new failure information; present to user; offer options (revise analysis, add diagnostics, end process); wait for user decision

update: Files to clean debug code from

bestPractices: Run the exact same test that was originally failing
Remove debug logging marked with '// TODO: REMOVE - Added by agent for debugging'
If still failing, present options to user
